hub.title: Welcome to Symbola
hub.body: This dashboard is your starting point: find your profile, your settings, and administration if you have the rights for it.

hub.title: Your settings
hub.body: Your company profile, VAT regime and lists (budget lines, sources, reasons) live here. The setup assistant pre-filled them; you can adjust them at any time.

hub.title: Help is always nearby
hub.body: Every screen has a "?" button that opens a short article on what you can do there. You can also relaunch this tour from that button.

events.title: Your events
events.body: This list gathers your leads and upcoming events; the “Past” tab keeps completed or lost events. Filter by name, year, status or source.

events.title: Creating a lead
events.body: “New lead” only needs a first name and the contact source; the date and venue can be added later.

events.title: An event's page
events.body: On the event page, follow the status, the budget and its vendors, the planning timeline and the day schedule, then invite your clients to follow their preparations.

events.title: Your templates
events.body: Find your sources, loss reasons and default budget lines, and your timeline and schedule templates: everything is ready since set-up, change it as you like.

events.title: Try without risk
events.body: The guided trial opens a complete fictional wedding to test everything; it is deleted when the trial ends. Relaunch this tour at any time with the “?” button.

quotes.title: Your catalogue
quotes.body: Save your reusable services here: label, unit, price excl. VAT, VAT rate and category. An archived item stays on the quotes that use it.

quotes.title: Composing a quote
quotes.body: From an event page, “Create a quote” assigns its number; add items, free lines and discounts, and totals are recalculated.

quotes.title: Deposits and signature
quotes.body: Plan the deposit schedule, then send the quote for signature: each signer receives their link by email, and the event becomes “Confirmed” once signed.

quotes.title: Invoices and payments
quotes.body: From a signed quote, issue deposit and balance invoices; track upcoming payments and prepare e-reporting period by period.

budget.title: Your budget models
budget.body: A split shares a total budget across your budget lines, in percentages adding up to 100%. It is optional: it suggests planned amounts.

budget.title: Simulating a budget
budget.body: On an event's page, “Suggest planned amounts” starts from a total and the number of guests, adjustable line by line.

budget.title: Planned, actual, variance
budget.body: Once the event is confirmed, the simulation becomes the planned budget; enter actual amounts, attach vendor quotes and follow the variance.

budget.title: Sharing with your clients
budget.body: Invited couples see their budget read-only in their space.

Tour.laterHint: "Later" keeps your place: the tour resumes here from the help bar.

event.title: An event's page
event.body: The whole event fits on this page, organised in tabs: each one groups part of the preparation.

event.title: Overview
event.body: Status, date, venue and activity feed: the essentials at a glance. Change the status when the client confirms.

event.title: The planning timeline
event.body: All the preparation tasks, month by month, with who does them. Start from a template: due dates are computed from the event date.

event.title: Vendors
event.body: The event's budget (venue, caterer, photographer…): vendor, status, planned and actual. You see at a glance what is left to book.

event.title: Find anything in a second
event.body: Type a client name, a quote number or a question in the search: it searches all your data.

vendors.title: Your vendor types
vendors.body: One pill per type: venue, hotel, caterer… You create them and choose their fields in the vendor book settings.

vendors.title: Filter and search around a place
vendors.body: Combine features, tags and “already worked with”; give a place and a radius to sort by distance.

vendors.title: Nearest first
vendors.body: The list follows the map, with an estimated travel time. From an event's budget line, “Add to line” sends it to the vendors consulted.

vendors.title: One vendor, one record
vendors.body: Create the record once: you will find it for every event, with the history of your prices.

login.title: Log in
login.body: Sign in with your email and password. After several failed attempts, the account is temporarily locked to protect it.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.body: The first time, scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy…). After that, just enter the 6-digit code each time you log in.

home.title: Dashboard
home.body: This is your home page. From here you reach your profile, your settings, and administration if you have the rights for it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Fill in your organization's company profile here (SIREN, address, legal form, business) and its VAT regime.

admin.title: Administration
admin.body: Create organizations, invite their owner, and enable or disable their modules. This page shows none of the organizations' business data.

adminSettings.title: Platform settings
adminSettings.body: These VAT exemption thresholds apply to every organization and must be kept up to date with current regulation.

adminHealth.title: Health
adminHealth.body: This page shows whether the application is responding and its deployed version, for a quick status check.

invitation.title: Create my account
invitation.body: This invitation link is personal and single-use. Choose a password to activate your account.

profile.title: My profile
profile.body: Choose the language Symbola displays for you.

eventsList.title: Event list
eventsList.body: Find your prospects and upcoming weddings here, and past ones in the “Finished” tab. Filter by name, year or status, then open an event to see its details. The guided tour can be relaunched with the “?” button, and the guided trial opens a fictional wedding to test everything.

eventsNew.title: New prospect
eventsNew.body: Enter at least one partner's first name and the prospect source (how they found you). The date and venue can be filled in later.

eventsDetail.title: Event details
eventsDetail.body: Track the event's progress here (prospect, quote sent, confirmed, done or lost) and its budget: each line (venue, caterer…) has its vendor, status, planned and actual amounts; the top bar counts booked lines out of required ones. A booked line needs the vendor's name; the amount is optional. The planning timeline starts once the event is confirmed: apply a template, add, check or reorder tasks. If the event date changes, the app offers to shift the due dates of unfinished tasks. The day schedule lists moments by time, with the icon of each vendor involved; the app flags, without blocking, a participant scheduled on two overlapping moments. Export it as a PDF: clients version (without internal notes) or vendors version. Invite your clients to follow their event from the “Clients” tab.

eventsSettings.title: Event settings
eventsSettings.body: Find your prospect sources (fair, Instagram, word of mouth…), your loss reasons, and the budget lines every new event receives, with their icon. They were prepared at set-up for your line of work: adapt them freely.

eventsTemplates.title: Planning timeline templates
eventsTemplates.body: Create your planning timeline templates, or load the starter template and adapt it. Each task is placed relative to the event date: 365 days before, 30 days before, event day… Apply a template from the page of an event with a date.

eventsProgramTemplates.title: Schedule templates
eventsProgramTemplates.body: Prepare your typical day schedules, or load the starter template and adapt it. Apply a template from an event's page: its moments are added to the schedule, and participants named like one of the event's budget lines are linked to it.

clientInvitation.title: Creating your account
clientInvitation.body: This account is personal: each member of the couple has their own. The invitation link is valid for 7 days; if it has expired, ask your planner for a new one.

clientSpace.title: Your space
clientSpace.body: Find here the weddings your planner shares with you. Open one to follow the planning timeline, check your tasks and see the wedding day schedule.

clientEvent.title: Following the preparations
clientEvent.body: Tasks “For you to do” are checked once done: your planner sees it right away. The others are handled by your planner. The day schedule can be downloaded as a PDF. The budget (planned, actual, variance per line) also shows, read-only, once it has been prepared.

clientSecurity.title: Two-factor authentication
clientSecurity.body: Optional for your account. Once enabled, a code from your authenticator app is asked at every login.

budgetSettings.title: Budget models
budgetSettings.body: A split (a percentage per budget line, total 100%) suggests planned amounts from a total. It is optional: an event's budget exists from its creation.

budgetDetail.title: Event budget
budgetDetail.body: Enter the total budget and the number of guests, choose a split: you get a planned amount per line and the cost per guest. Adjust a line by hand if needed, the remaining amount to allocate recalculates right away. Attach a vendor's quote to its line (PDF or image, 20 MB max): it is checked by the antivirus and opens through a temporary link.

quotesCatalog.title: Services catalogue
quotesCatalog.body: Your reusable items: label, unit, price excl. VAT, VAT rate and category. An archived item disappears from the choice but stays on the quotes that use it.

quotesSettings.title: Quote settings
quotesSettings.body: Default validity and numbering series prefixes (quotes, invoices, credit notes). Numbers are assigned per year, without gaps.

quotesDetail.title: Composing a quote
quotesDetail.body: Add catalogue items or free lines, adjust quantities, descriptions and discounts: totals are recalculated. Once sent, a version is frozen; to change it, create a new version.

quotesPayments.title: Upcoming payments
quotesPayments.body: Unpaid instalments of sent or signed quotes, sorted by date, with a total per month. A past instalment is flagged “Overdue” and shows on the dashboard. Trials never appear here.

quotesEReporting.title: E-reporting
quotesEReporting.body: For individual clients, e-invoicing is not mandatory but some data must be reported on your approved platform (from 1 September 2027). Choose a period, check the totals, then download the export.

importFile.title: Importing data
importFile.body: Choose what your file contains (events, tasks, budget, catalogue or a list), then drop it in: CSV, Excel (.xlsx) or JSON. Encoding, separator and header row are detected automatically; spreadsheet formulas are neutralised. The file is scanned by the antivirus and then discarded: only its rows are kept until the import is finished. Nothing is saved in your modules before the last step.

importColumns.title: Recognising columns
importColumns.body: Each column of your file gets a suggested field, based on its title (French or English) and its content (dates, amounts, e-mails). The confidence score tells how sure the suggestion is: below the threshold, tick the confirmation box or choose another field. A column “without equivalent” will be offered in the gaps report, to keep it as a free field on the record or ignore it. French dates (31/12/2026, 31.12.2026, 2026-12-31) and amounts (1 234,56 €) are recognised.

importMatches.title: Matching existing records
importMatches.body: For each row that looks like a record you already have (same clients and same date for an event, same label for an item or a list, same label within the same event for a task or a budget line), the app suggests a match with its similarity score. A matched row will update the existing record instead of creating a duplicate. Accept or refuse suggestions one by one or in bulk, or choose the record to match yourself. Tasks and budget lines must match one of your events without ambiguity.

importGaps.title: Gaps report
importGaps.body: The report first lists the columns without equivalent: keep them as a free field (shown on the record of each imported item) or ignore them. It then lists the rows that will not be imported, with their reason: invalid date or amount, missing required field, event not found for a task or a budget line. Download them as CSV to fix them in your spreadsheet, then import them again; the other rows are not blocked.

importConfirm.title: Confirming an import
importConfirm.body: The preview counts creations, updates and rejected rows, with a sample of each. A matched row updates the existing record: only its filled cells replace the current values. For an events import, choose the source given to events that have none; a source missing from your list is added to it. Confirming writes the whole import at once, or nothing if an error occurs.

importUndo.title: Import log and undo
importUndo.body: Each confirmed import is logged: file, author, date and result. During the undo period you can undo it: created records are deleted, updated records get their previous values back. A record changed by hand since the import is flagged and kept, unless you tick “undo anyway”. An event that received a quote is never deleted.

privacySearch.title: Searching for a person
privacySearch.body: Enter at least an e-mail, a phone number or a name: the search ignores accents and case, and compares phone numbers on their digits only (+33 or 0). It queries every subscribed module and gathers the person's data, then that of their events (tasks, budget, quotes, invoices). If a module does not answer, the result is flagged as incomplete: run the search again before answering the person. Data from a guided trial never appears.

privacyRequests.title: Tracking requests from individuals
privacyRequests.body: Record each request you receive (access, rectification, erasure, portability, objection) with its date received: the one-month legal deadline appears at once. A complex request can be extended once, with a required reason: three months in total from receipt. Requests whose deadline is close appear as an alert on the dashboard (threshold in the GDPR settings).

privacySettings.title: GDPR settings
privacySettings.body: These durations come from the specification (CNIL guidelines) and should be validated by a lawyer. They drive the monthly list of people to purge, which you always validate line by line. The alert threshold sets when a request appears on the dashboard.

privacyExport.title: GDPR exports
privacyExport.body: An export answers an access or portability request: tick the person's records in the search result, then export. You get a readable PDF and a reusable ZIP archive, kept in private storage. Each download goes through a link valid for a few minutes; the files are deleted automatically on the date shown. Your internal notes are part of the export: read it before sending it.

privacyErasure.title: Erasure request
privacyErasure.body: Record the request under “Requests from people”, search for the person, tick their records and ask for the preview: each record is deleted, anonymised or kept there (invoices 10 years, signed quotes 5 years, adjustable). Once confirmed, each module does its part and acknowledges; the request closes when all have responded. Statistics (source, status, amounts) stay accurate. Then download the timestamped proof and send the proposed reply.

privacyPurge.title: Monthly purge
privacyPurge.body: Each month, the list gathers what has passed its retention period (GDPR settings): prospects with no follow-up, clients whose relationship has ended, inactive couple accounts, invoices and signed quotes at the end of their retention. Confirm it: each line is purged (anonymised or deleted, statistics kept), except the ones you exclude with a reason; they will come back the following month. Nothing is purged without your confirmation.

allTasks.title: Tasks across all your weddings
allTasks.body: Every task of your current events, sorted by due date. Tick a task to mark it done; click it to edit it on its wedding's page.

allQuotes.title: Your quotes
allQuotes.body: Every quote you made. A quote is created from its event page; deposit and balance invoices are issued from the signed quote.

adminAccounts.title: Accounts and support
adminAccounts.body: To unblock someone in an organisation's team: see whether their two-factor authentication is set up, whether their account is locked, and when they last signed in. "Reset two-factor authentication" is for a lost or replaced phone: the person is notified by e-mail and will scan a new QR code. "Resend the invitation" sends a new link and disables the old one. A forgotten password is handled without you, from the sign-in screen. Every action is logged.

adminActivity.title: Organisation activity
adminActivity.body: Usage statistics to gauge interest in the application: number of accounts, accounts signed in over 30 days, last sign-in, and the number of events, quotes and invoices created each month. Never a name, an amount or any content; guided trials do not count.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.body: Enter your account's address: a link valid for 30 minutes is sent to you to choose a new password. The message is the same whether or not the address has an account. Your two-factor authentication does not change.

adminOnboarding.title: Organisations getting started
adminOnboarding.body: This table shows, for each team account, the tutorials finished and in progress and the last help activity. It helps spot who needs a hand; it shows no event data.

vendorBook.title: The vendor book
vendorBook.body: Each vendor has a single record, reused from one event to the next: contact details, features depending on its type, brochures, and the history of your work together. Filter by type, by features and around a place; add a vendor to an event's budget line to compare quotes.

Events.starterProgramLoaded: Starter template loaded: adapt it to the way you work.

Events.trialEnded: Trial ended: its fictional data has been deleted.

Events.trialStepVendor: book a vendor and enter its amount;
Events.trialStepTask: check a planning timeline task, then change the date to see the proposed recalculation;
Events.trialStepProgram: add a schedule line and download the PDF (“Fictional document” watermark).
Events.trialEnd: End the trial and delete its data
Events.trialNoInvite: During the trial, no invitation is sent: the couple is only invited on a real event.
Events.confirmBudgetTitle: Make the simulation the planned budget
Events.confirmBudgetBody: The event is confirmed and a simulation already exists: you can use it as the planned amounts, line by line.
Events.trialStepQuote: Compose a fictional quote, have the fictional couple sign it on the trial signing page, then issue its invoices (DEMO series, watermarked).

Events.sourcesIntro: Where your couples come from. Asked when creating a prospect, it shows which channels bring you the most.
Events.lossReasonsIntro: Why a project did not go ahead. Asked when an event moves to “Lost”.
Events.vendorDetailHint: Pick a line in the table to change its status, vendor or amounts.

Events.allTasksSummary: {count, plural, =0 {No task to do} one {# task to do} other {# tasks to do}} · {overdue} overdue
Events.allTasksEmpty: Nothing to do: everything is up to date.
Events.budgetSuggest: Suggest planned amounts, history and attached quotes
Events.retroplanningAfterConfirm: The planning timeline starts once the event is confirmed: set it to “Confirmed” to apply your template.
Events.proposeRetroplanningTitle: The event is confirmed: apply the planning timeline?
Events.proposeRetroplanningBody: Tasks are calculated from the event date. Choose the template (yours is already selected).
Events.placesHint: Entered once, then chosen in the schedule.

send_quote.title: Next step: send the quote
send_quote.body: The prospect is waiting for your proposal. Draft the quote from this event and send it.

prepare_program.title: Next step: prepare the wedding-day schedule
prepare_program.body: The event is getting close and its schedule is empty. Start from a template or add the first moments.

invite_clients.title: Next step: invite the couple
invite_clients.body: Give them access to their space: their tasks, the budget, the options you suggest.

Budget.title: Budget
Budget.moduleUnavailable: The Budget module is not enabled for your organization.
Budget.unauthenticated: Your session has expired. Sign in again and try again.

Quotes.noCatalogItems: No item in the catalogue yet.

Quotes.invalidValidity: Validity must be between 1 and 365 days.
Quotes.invalidPrefix: Invalid prefix: capital letters and digits, up to 8 characters, DEMO excluded.
Quotes.vatRegimeInProfile: The VAT regime, address and SIREN printed on your quotes are set in

Quotes.quoteSent: Quote sent: this version is frozen.
Quotes.quoteEmpty: Add at least one line before sending the quote.

Quotes.quoteNotFound: This quote does not exist or no longer exists.

Quotes.scheduleNotPayable: Only an instalment of a sent or signed quote can be marked as paid.

Quotes.markedUnpaid: Payment cancelled: the instalment is due again.

Quotes.invalidHorizon: The horizon must be between 1 and 730 days.
Quotes.missingPaymentMethod: The payment method name is required.

Quotes.signatureSent: Quote sent for signature: the links have been emailed.
Quotes.invalidSigners: Each signer needs a name, a valid email and a billing address (four at most).
Quotes.signatureNotSendable: This quote cannot be sent for signature in its current state.
Quotes.signatureAlreadyRequested: This version is already out for signature.
Quotes.signatureUnavailable: Online signature is not available yet: it will be enabled once the signature service is set up.
Quotes.noInvoices: No invoice issued for this quote.
Quotes.issueInvoiceHint: An issued invoice gets its final number and can no longer be edited or deleted: corrections go through a credit note.

Quotes.issueCreditNoteFor: Issue a credit note on invoice {number}
Quotes.invoiceNotFound: This invoice does not exist or no longer exists.

AdminOnboarding.title: Organisations getting started
AdminOnboarding.intro: Tours and tutorials followed by each team account. No event data: only progress in the help, to see who needs a hand.

Tutorials.exampleNote: The examples created here are fictional: marked "Trial", they are deleted at the end of the tutorial (or after 24 hours if abandoned).

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Each event has its page: status, vendors, planning timeline, programme, quotes and clients, organised in tabs. Let's create a fictional birthday party to go through it.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates "Camille's 40th birthday party", with its budget and starter tasks.

steps.title: Confirm the event
steps.body: Open the example, Overview tab, and set its status to "Confirmed", as when a client agrees.

steps.title: Book a vendor
steps.body: In the Budget tab, pick a line (the caterer, for example), set it to "Booked" and enter a vendor name.

steps.title: Tick a task
steps.body: In the Planning timeline tab, tick a task as done: the event's progress updates.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to follow an event from start to finish. The example will be deleted.

retroplanning-template.keep: Keep the template as a base

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: A planning template lists, once and for all, the tasks of a type of event with their lead time before the day. Applied to an event, it creates every task with its date.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional company retreat and an "Express retreat" template to work from.

steps.title: Look at the template
steps.body: The template appears in Settings › Events › Planning templates: each task has its lead time (90 days before, for example) and who does it.

steps.title: Apply the template
steps.body: Open the example, Planning timeline tab, choose "Express retreat" and click "Apply template": the tasks arrive with their due dates.

steps.title: Move the date
steps.body: In the Overview tab, change the event date: Symbola offers to recompute the due dates. Accept and watch them follow.

steps.title: Keep or delete
steps.body: The example event will be deleted. Do you want to keep "Express retreat" as a base for your own templates?

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The catalogue lists your services with their price, unit and VAT. A quote is built in a few clicks from the catalogue, without retyping anything.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola notes your catalogue's current state to recognise the service you are about to add.

steps.title: Add a service
steps.body: Open the catalogue and add a service: a label, a unit and a price are enough.

steps.title: What it is for
steps.body: In every quote, "Add from catalogue" picks up this service with its price and VAT. Changing the catalogue never changes a quote already sent.

steps.title: Keep or delete
steps.body: Do you keep this service in your catalogue?

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: A quote is written from an event's page, sent, then signed online by your clients. Once signed, it confirms the event.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding and an example quote, already filled with lines and a payment schedule.

steps.title: Send for signature
steps.body: Open the example quote, click "Send the quote" then "Send for signature". During an example no e-mail is sent: the signing links show on the quote.

steps.title: Sign
steps.body: Open a signing link shown on the quote and sign on behalf of each client. The quote becomes "Signed".

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to get a quote signed online. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Once the quote is signed, you invoice each deposit of the schedule, then the balance. Numbering is continuous and an issued invoice never changes (corrections go through a credit note).

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional gala and its example quote, with a payment schedule.

steps.title: Get the quote signed
steps.body: Open the example quote: send it, send it for signature, then sign through the links shown.

steps.title: Invoice the deposit
steps.body: On the signed quote, in the schedule, click "Invoice" on the deposit. The example invoice uses a separate numbering: it never uses up your real numbers.

steps.title: Invoice the balance
steps.body: Now invoice the balance: it takes the quote total minus the deposits already invoiced.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to invoice a deposit then the balance. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The split suggests a planned amount per line from a total, then the budget compares planned and actual as bookings come in.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional christening to simulate a budget for.

steps.title: Simulate the budget
steps.body: Open the example's budget, enter an envelope and a number of guests, choose an allocation model and run the simulation.

steps.title: Enter an actual
steps.body: Enter an actual amount on a line: the difference with the plan shows, in terracotta if over budget.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to simulate and follow a budget. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: The day's programme lists the moments of the event, hour by hour, with the vendors involved. It downloads in two versions: for clients and for vendors.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding with an empty programme.

steps.title: Start from a template
steps.body: Open the example's Day programme tab, choose a programme template and apply it (or add a first line).

steps.title: Download
steps.body: Still in the Programme tab, download the vendors' version: internal notes only appear there, never in the clients' version.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to prepare the day's programme. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Your clients can follow their event's preparation in their own space: their tasks, the programme and the budget, never your internal notes or your other events.

steps.title: Create the example
steps.body: Symbola creates a fictional wedding anniversary, with its tasks.

steps.title: The Clients tab
steps.body: In the example's Couple tab, you will invite your clients by e-mail (during an example no invitation is sent). You can remove their access at any time.

steps.title: What they see
steps.body: In the planning timeline, "Clients" tasks are the ones they will see and can tick; their ticks appear in your activity feed.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to open your clients' space. The example will be deleted.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: Import brings in your existing data from a file (Excel, CSV or JSON): you match the columns, check a preview, then confirm. An import can be undone for 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola notes your current imports to recognise the one you are about to start.

steps.title: Start an import
steps.body: Open Import data and drop a small file of a few lines, for example an export from your spreadsheet. Go as far as the preview.

steps.title: Check before confirming
steps.body: The preview shows what will be created and the gaps detected. Nothing is saved until you confirm: if it was a test, abandon the import.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: You know how to bring in your existing data.

steps.title: Understand
steps.body: For one budget line (the caterer of a gala, the venue of a retreat…), you often consult several vendors. Symbola keeps them side by side with their quote and your notes until you select one.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.body: Symbola creates an example event (a charity gala) and, if you have the vendor book, two example caterers. Everything will be deleted at the end.

steps.title: Consult two vendors
steps.body: In the example's “Caterer” budget line, add two consulted vendors: pick them from your vendor book or simply type their name.

steps.title: Record a quote
steps.body: For one of them, enter the quote amount (or attach the file). You can also add a note, internal or shown to the clients.

steps.title: Select
steps.body: Click “Select” on the vendor you choose: the line becomes Booked with its name and amount, and the other one stays visible as “not selected”.

steps.title: What the clients see
steps.body: Tick “Show to clients” on a vendor: your clients find it in their space with the notes ticked “Clients”, never your internal notes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: The example and its example vendors will be deleted.

Setup.title: Welcome: let's set up your space
Setup.intro: Everything is already filled in for your line of work: review, adjust if needed, then “Validate and continue”. You can change everything later in Settings.

titles.5: Where your clients come from, why a project falls through

explanations.1: Your line of work sets the starting settings: budget lines, timeline, day schedule, lead sources…
explanations.2: This information appears on your quotes and invoices.
explanations.3: It sets the legal notices on your quotes and invoices. A later change will have an effective date.
explanations.4: The budget lines of every new event: you track consulted vendors, quotes, planned and actual amounts. We prepared those of your line of work, with their icon: rename, change the icon, remove or add.
explanations.5: The source is asked for each new lead; the reason when a project is lost. They feed your statistics.
explanations.6: We prepared a timeline, a day schedule and a budget split. You can change them whenever you like.
